# Accura Design System

> Self-contained design system for Accura. A **re-theme** of the Agentic Design System: the rules are inherited unchanged, the values are Accura's. Everything an agent needs is in this repository — no external vault or absolute paths.

**Read order for any UI/token work:**
1. `accura-theme.md` — Accura's values and the 11 open questions
2. `docs/design-system-rules.md` — the inherited ruleset (**read its override header first**)
3. the relevant `docs/component-specs/[Name].md` and `docs/machine-readable/artifacts/components/[name].meta.json`

---

## Precedence — this matters

`docs/design-system-rules.md` is vendored from Agentic and contains **both rules and Agentic's values**.

- **Rules** (naming, semantic layer, paired-surface rule, spacing scale, layout, dark mode) → follow exactly.
- **Values** (brand hue, anchor step, ring, sidebar, button radius, status borders, font, the contrast table) → **`accura-theme.md` wins**.

The override table at the top of `docs/design-system-rules.md` lists every known conflict. If you find a new one, add it there rather than editing the rule text.

---

## Rules and process

- `docs/design-system-rules.md`: Token architecture, every semantic token name and rule, spacing system, layout grid, Figma ↔ Tailwind mapping, dark mode. **Inherited — do not edit the rules.**
- `accura-theme.md`: Accura's theme — brand ramp, neutral, radius, spacing, type, plus the semantic/component deviations and 11 open questions. **The authority on values.**
- `docs/content-guidelines.md`: Voice-neutral UX writing — capitalisation, button labels, error messages, empty states.

## Skills — read before the matching task

| Task | Read |
|---|---|
| Audit a component | `docs/skills/Component Audit Skill.md` + `docs/tracking/Audit Status.md` |
| Build a Figma component | `docs/skills/Build component skill.md` |
| Bind or fix tokens | `docs/skills/Token Binding Skill.md` |
| Write component docs | `docs/skills/Component Documentation Skill.md` |
| Any Storybook work | `docs/skills/Storybook Build Process.md` |
| Re-theme / re-skin | `docs/skills/Theme Generator Skill.md` |
| Implement a component in code | `docs/skills/Component implementation process.md` |

## Component documentation

- `docs/component-specs/[Name].md` — **38 files**: 36 component specs, plus `docs/component-specs/_template.md` and `docs/component-specs/Form-shared.md` (shared `label`, `menu-dropdown`, `menu-dropdown-item`).
- `docs/machine-readable/artifacts/components/[name].meta.json` — **36 files**, v3 schema: variants, tokens per state, storybook reference, known issues, dark-mode risks.
- `docs/machine-readable/component-quick-reference.md` — scan before building any screen.
- `docs/machine-readable/component-directory.md` — Figma node ID ↔ Storybook title ↔ tsx file.
- `docs/machine-readable/meta-artifact-template.md` — required fields for any new meta.json.
- `docs/machine-readable/generation-rules.md` — when to regenerate a meta.json.
- `docs/machine-readable/figma-ids.md` — Figma node, effect-style and text-style IDs. ⚠️ IDs are Agentic's; Accura's Figma file is different — verify before use.
- `docs/machine-readable/validate-artifacts.mjs` · `drift-check.mjs` — validation scripts.

## Code — `accura-ui/`

Next.js + Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui. Forked from `agentic-ui`; identical components, Accura tokens.

```bash
cd accura-ui && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && npm run storybook   # → :6007
```

- `accura-ui/src/app/tokens.css` — **345 CSS custom properties** (450 declarations, including `.dark` overrides), generated from Figma. `:root` light, `.dark` dark. **Not a plain copy of `tokens/output/css/variables.css`** — it carries a different ordering, extra descriptive comments, and the hand-applied `--font-family-sans: Inter` override. Change the Figma variable, rebuild with `tokens/sd.build.mjs`, then patch the changed properties into this file surgically. Copying the generated file over it wipes the overrides.
- `accura-ui/src/components/ui/*.tsx` — 38 component files.
- `accura-ui/src/stories/*.stories.tsx` — 35 story files.
- `accura-ui/.storybook/preview.tsx` — light/dark via `withThemeByClassName`.
- `accura-ui/CLAUDE.md` — agent rules for the code side. Read before writing any component.

⚠️ `chat-bubble.tsx` exists with no story — ChatBubble was removed from Storybook. The Screens/Northwind templates were also removed.

## Tokens — `tokens/`

DTCG source + Style Dictionary build. **Exported from Accura's Figma file** — 228 primitives, 115 semantics (Light + Dark), 47 component tokens.

> `stepper/border` aliases a **primitive** directly rather than a semantic — a deliberate Accura rule deviation, see `accura-theme.md` §7. It exists in Figma and survives re-export.

```bash
cd tokens && npm install && node sd.build.mjs   # → output/css/, output/js/
```

| File | |
|---|---|
| `primitives.tokens.json` | 228 raw values |
| `semantics.tokens.json` | 115 semantics, **Light** mode |
| `semantics.dark.tokens.json` | the same 115 in **Dark** — source for the `.dark` block |
| `components.tokens.json` | 47 component tokens |
| `tokens.tokens.json` | all three combined |
| `sd.build.mjs` · `validate-contrast.mjs` | build + contrast gate |
| `output/` | generated — `variables.css` (403 props), `tailwind-v4.css`, `tokens.mjs` |

**Two shape fixes are applied during export — preserve them if you rewrite the exporter:**

1. **DTCG forbids a node being both a token and a group.** Figma has `color/background/default` *and* `color/background/default/foreground`. The child is collapsed onto its parent segment → `color.background.default-foreground`. Same CSS variable name, but now reachable and referenceable. Without this the build fails and every `/foreground` token is silently dropped — the inherited Agentic export has exactly that bug (8 unresolved references).
2. **Semantics that alias an identically-named primitive** (`color/chart/1` → `color/chart/1`) become self-referential once collections share one namespace. Those 10 are inlined as literal values.

⚠️ `tokens/output/` is **not** what Storybook consumes. `accura-ui/src/app/tokens.css` is generated directly from Figma and is the runtime source of truth. Do not overwrite it from `tokens/output/` without checking the divergence table below.

## Tracking

Both reset to Accura's real state on 2026-09-08. Agentic's ticks did not transfer — the brand ramp, sidebar, button radius and status borders all changed, so its verification certified nothing here.

- `docs/tracking/AI-Readiness.md` — 15-factor assessment **scored for Accura**, the measured counts, and the root-cause analysis of why docs drift (restated values and counts, not aliases). Read before trusting any inherited ✅.
- `docs/tracking/Storybook Status.md` — **3 of 36 stories verified for Accura** (Sidebar, Stepper, AlertDialog). The rest are inherited-unverified. Lists the highest-risk components to check first.
- `docs/tracking/Audit Status.md` — **zero R1–R8 audits run against Accura's Figma file.** The largest gap in the system. Includes a suggested audit order.

## Changelog

- `CHANGELOG.md` — every Accura-specific change, with the breaking ones called out. **Record breaking changes here before they ship.**

## Figma

**Accura DS file:** `32llw6anFsjPISJrrp1and` — `[Accura] Agentic Design System`
Collections: Primitives `1:2` (Value) · Semantics `1:129` (Light/Dark) · Components `17:4484` (Light)
228 primitives · 115 semantics (Light + Dark) · 47 component tokens · 17 text styles
(Published-library counts are lower — 190 / 113 — because some variables are hidden from publishing. `tokens/` is exported from the **local** file, which is complete.)

**Known drift:** two Accura libraries exist. `[Accura One] WebApp` consumes `[Accura] Agentic Design System`; `[Accura One] Website Design` consumes `[Accura] Agentic Design System (beta) (Copy)`. They hold **different values for the same token names** (sidebar background, button radius). This repo documents the **non-Copy** library. See open question Q8 in `accura-theme.md`.

Tooling: `figma-cli` — `cd ~/figma-cli && node src/index.js eval "..."`. Requires the FigCli plugin running in the target Figma file.

---

## Known divergences between this repo and Figma

**One token only.** `sidebar/accent` and `sidebar/accent/foreground` were reconciled in Figma and now match.

| Token | Figma / `tokens/output` | `accura-ui/src/app/tokens.css` | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| `color/sidebar/ring` | `#2b7fff` blue (dark `#51a2ff`) | **`#17bb77` green** | brand-correct; Figma not yet updated |

Regenerating `accura-ui/src/app/tokens.css` straight from Figma **would revert the green ring**. Either update `color/sidebar/ring` in Figma first, or re-apply the override after regenerating.

`sidebar/active` and `active/foreground` alias `accent` and `accent/foreground` in Figma, so they follow automatically.
